src6.text:
Dafydd Penhallow is a ripener who tends the caves, and the work email on record is yusuf.adeyemi@fennelcote.example.

The Copperkettle Spring batch is Alpine Gruyère-style. Haruto Egashira is its curator and Ottilie Brandreth its keeper. It holds 10 wheels weighing 10.4 kg and was made on 2026-03-02. No wheel has been tasted yet, and nobody has described its rind.

The Frostline Reserve batch is Smoked Gouda Rind style. Haruto Egashira is its curator and Dafydd Penhallow its keeper. It holds 40 wheels weighing 21.0 g and was made on 2025-11-03. Its first wheel was tasted on 2026-09-30, and its rind is described as a waxy red coat.

The Thistle Meadow Lot batch is Blue Persillé. Dafydd Penhallow is its curator and Ottilie Brandreth its keeper. It holds 22 wheels weighing 16.7 kg and was made on 2026-06-11. No wheel has been tasted yet, and its rind is described as a waxy red coat.

Thistle Meadow Lot entered Bloom Room for maturing on 2024-05-19 and was withdrawn on 2026-07-21. It is also in Brine Alcove for maturing, entered on 2024-11-08, with no withdrawal date recorded. Blue Hollow Lot 3 is in Cave Three for washing, entered on 2025-01-22, with no withdrawal date recorded. Copperkettle Spring is in Bloom Room for washing, entered on 2024-09-16, with no withdrawal date recorded. Juniper Ridge Batch is in Brine Alcove for washing, entered on 2025-01-22 and withdrawn on 2026-02-14. Juniper Ridge Batch is in Old Slate Door for drying, entered on 2024-05-19, with no withdrawal date recorded. This replaces an earlier statement about the same stay, and only the cave changed.

Receipt RC-0001 records a counter sale of part of Old Mill Wheel Run on 2025-12-02 for a total of 5600 minor units in EUR. Receipt RC-0017 records a sale of part of Blue Hollow Lot 3 on 2026-07-19 for a total of 1260 minor units in CHF. Receipt RC-0108 records a sale of part of Frostline Reserve on 2026-07-19 for a total of 2400 minor units in GBP.
